title: ZOMBIE APOCALYPSE: YOU DECIDE
tagline: Every night the story stops. You comment. The most votes decide.

max.name: Max
max.blurb: A quiet survivor with a good heart and a failing car.

biscuit.name: Biscuit
biscuit.blurb: Max's dog. Small ears, big courage, always hungry.

ada.name: Ada
ada.blurb: Found at the gas station. Fast hands, faster plans.

old.name: Otto
old.blurb: An old trucker who knows every back road.

zombie.name: The shamblers
zombie.blurb: They listen for sound. They never hurry. They never stop.

intro.subtitle: The Empty Highway
intro.hook: At 2:47 AM, Max's engine dies on an empty road. One gas station is still lit.

lines.text: 2:47 AM. Max's engine coughs, sputters, and dies.
Inside, Biscuit whines. No signal, no help, no plan.
Then Max spots it: one gas station still glowing in the dark.
He grabs his backpack and climbs out. 'Stay close, Biscuit.'
The station is lit, but a shadow moves behind the locked door.
RUN to escape or CHECK the door? Follow and vote on tomorrow's Reel.

store_sound.subtitle: Staff Only
store_sound.hook: The store has food for weeks. And something is dragging its feet behind the STAFF ONLY door.

lines.text: The gas station is empty. Too empty.
Inside the store: water, cans, batteries. Everything Max needs to keep Biscuit alive.
Then he hears it. Behind the STAFF ONLY door, something heavy drags across the floor.
Then silence. The storeroom has food for weeks. And whatever made that sound.
Should Max RUN and leave it all behind? Or CHECK what is inside?

choices.text: RUN - slip out and drive away

run_away.subtitle: Do Not Look Back
run_away.hook: Max ran. The car started. Some things you cannot unhear.

lines.text: Max backs out slowly. Quiet steps. Biscuit walks so close, he can feel him breathing.
The dragging stops. Then the door handle turns. Max runs.
The car starts on the first try. Sometimes luck is a plan.
At sunrise, Max checks the bag. Fuel: enough. Food: almost nothing.
But they are alive. And ahead, a motel sign is still glowing.

check_back.subtitle: The Door
check_back.hook: Behind the door was not a monster. It was something worse: hope.

lines.text: Max grabs a tire iron. His hands shake. But Biscuit is hungry, and that decides it.
Inside: a girl, crouched behind the crates, holding a box cutter. Alive.
One step and I scream, she says. And screaming would bring them all.
Max drops the tire iron. I have a car. You have food. Deal?
Her name is Ada. Two days alone in here. And in her bag: a shortwave radio.

motel_arrive.subtitle: Vacancy
motel_arrive.hook: Twelve motel doors. One old truck. And a sign that still says VACANCY.

lines.text: By sunrise they reach a roadside motel. Twelve doors, one old truck.
The sign says VACANCY. Somebody checked in a very long time ago.
They take room six. Door locked. Curtains closed. For one day, they sleep.
Biscuit sleeps against the door. Always on guard.
Then comes 3:04 in the morning.

motel_door.subtitle: 3:04 AM
motel_door.hook: Scratch. Scratch. A voice at the motel door whispers: Please... open.

lines.text: Scratch. Scratch. Right on the door.
Then a whisper, soft and tired. Please... I am hurt. Open the door.
The peephole is broken. The voice could be anyone. Or any thing.
Ada grips the box cutter. Biscuit shows his teeth.
Open the door... or stay quiet until morning?

open_door.subtitle: In From the Rain
open_door.hook: The stranger was kind, hurt, and hiding something under his jacket.

lines.text: Max opens the door and pulls the stranger inside. An old man, soaked and bleeding.
His name is Otto. He was a trucker. He knows a shortcut over the mountains.
But the bite on his arm is dark. He hides it under his jacket.
They drive all night. Otto sleeps. Max keeps one eye on the mirror.

stay_quiet.subtitle: Until Morning
stay_quiet.hook: At dawn the hallway was empty. The door had scratches... and a handprint.

lines.text: Nobody moves. The whisper becomes scratching. The scratching becomes knocking.
Max pushes the dresser against the door and waits in the dark.
At dawn, the hallway is empty. The door has deep scratches. And a handprint.
They leave fast, without the food from the office fridge.

route_pick.subtitle: Two Roads
route_pick.hook: The radio tower is ninety kilometers north. Forest shortcut, or the open highway?

lines.text: The radio tower is ninety kilometers north. Two roads can get them there.
The forest road is shorter. Darker. No signal, no help.
The highway is open. But every town on it was evacuated badly.
FOREST shortcut... or HIGHWAY detour?

forest_road.subtitle: Shapes in the Fog
forest_road.hook: They stood between the trees. Arms hanging. Waiting for a sound.

lines.text: The forest swallows the road. Ada drives. Nobody talks.
An hour in, shapes appear in the fog. Standing. Arms hanging.
Biscuit growls, low. Max puts a hand on his head. Quiet, boy.
They roll past, engine low. One of them turns its head.
Two hundred meters later, the fog keeps their secret.

highway_road.subtitle: The Blocked Bridge
highway_road.hook: The bridge was full of silent cars. Then one alarm started screaming.

lines.text: The first twenty kilometers of highway are almost normal. That is the scary part.
Then the bridge. Jammed with empty cars, door to door.
They walk between the cars. Then a car alarm screams.
On the far bank: dozens of them. Drawn by every sound. By their sound.
They run the last kilometer and learn one rule. Noise is death.

tower_arrive.subtitle: Lookout Tower Three
tower_arrive.hook: There is a light at the top of the tower. But nobody answers the door.

lines.text: At dusk they find it. Lookout Tower Three, in the middle of nothing.
The door at the base is chained from the inside. Which means someone is here.
A light moves at the top. The radio voice brought them here. Now: silence.
Call out... or climb the ladder in the dark?

choices.text: CALL OUT - knock and shout hello

call_out.subtitle: Hello?
call_out.hook: The word hello rolled away into the dark. Then a lantern moved.

lines.text: Max cups his hands. Hello! We heard your message! The word rolls away into the dark.
Silence. Then a lantern moves across the window.
A woman's voice. Put your weapon down and walk to the light.
Her name is Mara. Twenty one days alone. She knows this forest like a map.
And tonight, the radio has news. A convoy is moving east. To the sea.

climb_up.subtitle: The Ladder
climb_up.hook: At the top: an empty chair, cold coffee, and a light nobody turned off.

lines.text: The ladder sings in the wind. Bolt by bolt, Max climbs into the dark.
At the top: an empty chair. Cold coffee. And a light nobody turned off.
Then a sound behind him. Slow. Hungry.
A ranger. Still in his vest. Still up here.
Max swings his bag once, hard. Then he pockets the radio and the beans. Sorry, ranger.

broadcast.subtitle: You Are Live
broadcast.hook: Two voices answer the radio: a convoy going to the sea, or a voice from the dead city.

lines.text: Max turns every dial. Static. Static. Then two voices break through.
First: a convoy, heading east. We reach the sea in three days. You are welcome.
Second: a voice from the city. Slow. Careful. To whoever hears this... we know how it started.
Safe water with strangers... or the truth, in a dead city?

choices.text: CONVOY - drive east to the sea

end_coast.subtitle: The Coast

ending.title: ENDING - THE COAST
ending.subtitle: You chose safety. The sea keeps its promise.

end_coast.hook: The convoy was real. There was hot food, a generator, and a boat.

lines.text: The convoy is real. Twenty three people. Four trucks. One boat.
There is hot food. A generator. Children who laugh at Biscuit's ears.
That night, Max sleeps with both eyes closed. For the first time since day one.
But the city is still talking. And the voice knows his name.
Season one: complete. The city remembers Max.

choices.location_text: a dead city far east, where the signal comes from

end_city.subtitle: The Origin

ending.title: ENDING - THE ORIGIN
ending.subtitle: You chose the truth. The city was waiting.

end_city.hook: The car pointed east. The city rose slowly, and one window was lit.

lines.text: Max points the car east. Ada does not argue. Biscuit rides shotgun.
The city rises slowly. Broken towers, dark windows... and one light on.
The broadcast came from a research lab. The front door is already open.
Inside: walls of notes, empty cages, and a recording still playing.
Season one: complete. Season two: the truth.

choices.location_text: inside the city lab, where the recording plays

intro.subtitle: City of Echoes
intro.hook: The city is quiet. Even the wind walks carefully here.

lines.text: The city is quiet. Even the wind walks carefully here.
The signal comes from a tall brick building, past a river of broken cars.
Ada checks the map. Two ways in. The metro tunnels, or the open streets.
Biscuit smells the air and does not like it.

pick.subtitle: Tunnels or Streets
pick.hook: The metro is fast and dark. The streets are open and watched.

lines.text: The metro is faster. Dark, but straight to the lab.
The streets are open. Nowhere to be trapped. And nowhere to hide.
METRO... or STREETS?

metro_run.subtitle: The Long Tunnel
metro_run.hook: The tunnel ate their footsteps. Ahead, slow shapes followed the echo.

lines.text: The tunnel eats their footsteps. Biscuit's nails click like a clock.
In the dark ahead: slow shapes, dragging feet, following the echo.
Ada finds a service door. It opens with a sound that lasts forever.
They slip through and shut it. Something hits the other side. Once.

street_run.subtitle: The Open Street
street_run.hook: Every step on the glass was a shout. Then a shopping cart rolled.

lines.text: The streets are wide, dead, and full of glass. Every step is a shout.
Halfway there, a shopping cart rolls. Then a dozen heads turn.
They run. Biscuit is faster than all of them.
Ada kicks the lab door open and slams it behind them.

lab_inside.subtitle: The Voice
lab_inside.hook: The voice is coming from upstairs. It knows why the world ended.

lines.text: The lab is cold. Empty cages. Walls of notes. A radio still talking.
The voice repeats. Come up. I will open the door. I have been waiting.
Ada whispers, what if it is a trap? Biscuit stares up the stairs.
TRUST the voice... or BURN the stairs and walk away?

choices.text: TRUST - climb up and meet the voice
BURN - light it and walk away

end_truth.subtitle: The Truth

ending.title: ENDING - THE TRUTH
ending.subtitle: Some doors open inward. Some answers open old wounds.

end_truth.hook: Upstairs: a woman, a hundred maps, and one honest sentence.

lines.text: Upstairs: a small room, a woman, and a hundred maps of the outbreak.
Her name is Dr. Wren. She was there on day zero. She kept the samples.
It was not a virus, she says. It was a warning. And it is not finished.
Max looks at Biscuit, then at Ada. Whatever comes next, they face it together.
Season two: complete. Season three: coming soon.

choices.location_text: a riverside settlement where Dr. Wren's radio signal leads

end_burn.subtitle: The Quiet Way

ending.title: ENDING - THE QUIET WAY
ending.subtitle: Some answers cost too much. They chose the river instead.

end_burn.hook: The lab burned. On the quiet edge of the city, a farmhouse had a porch and a well.

lines.text: Max tips a can of lamp oil down the stairs and lights it. The past can burn.
They walk away from the tower of smoke, toward the quiet edge of the city.
Some answers cost too much, Ada says. Max agrees.
They find a small farmhouse by the river. It has a porch. It has a well.
Season two: complete. Season three: coming soon.

choices.location_text: a quiet riverside farmhouse beyond the city

arrival.subtitle: The River Settlement
arrival.hook: By sunrise, the river is calm—but every farmhouse window is lit.

lines.text: You reach a riverside settlement just before sunrise.
A radio crackles from inside. Someone on the other side knows your names.
The gate hangs open. Two sets of footprints head in different directions.

gate.subtitle: At the Gate
gate.hook: Someone is watching from behind the curtains. Do you announce yourself or scout first?

lines.text: The porch light flickers twice, then goes dark.
Biscuit growls at the fence line. The footprints are fresh.

porch.subtitle: The Porch
porch.hook: The door opens three inches. A trembling voice says: You came back.

lines.text: A woman opens the door but keeps one hand on the chain.
She insists she has never met you. Her radio says otherwise.
The radio repeats a location: the old watchtower by the bridge.

tracks.subtitle: Two Trails
tracks.hook: One trail disappears into the barn. The other crosses the old bridge.

lines.text: Mud on the first trail is mixed with oil and straw.
Across the river, a signal flashes from the bridge railing.

barn.subtitle: The Barn
barn.hook: The barn door is locked from the inside. Something gently taps back.

lines.text: You find a warning scratched into the wood: do not trust the radio.
Biscuit finds a fresh blanket and a half-eaten meal. Someone escaped moments ago.
A map beneath the blanket marks a single safe road out.

bridge_watch.subtitle: The Bridge
bridge_watch.hook: The flashing signal is a mirror tied to the railing. Someone is signaling back.

lines.text: Across the bridge, an empty radio is still broadcasting.
The transmission contains tomorrow's date—and a description of your car.
The voice says there are survivors on the road, but only until dark.

radio.subtitle: The Voice
radio.hook: The radio says it can lead you to survivors. But it asks you to reveal your location.

lines.text: Static fades. A calm voice gives you a choice.
Outside, the tower light turns on although its power line is cut.

signal.subtitle: The Reply
signal.hook: You answer. The voice whispers: Thank you. Now they can find you.

lines.text: You give a false location, but the radio clicks before you finish.
A car horn sounds far away—then three more answer it.
Someone has found the settlement. You have one chance to choose a road.

tower_watch.subtitle: The Watchtower
tower_watch.hook: At the tower, you find a radio transmitter wired to an empty room.

lines.text: The transmitter has been running on a car battery for weeks.
The logbook shows the same message repeated every night: keep moving.
Beyond the river, two roads lead toward two different lights.

leader.subtitle: Two Roads
leader.hook: The settlement is no longer safe. One light leads to an old highway; the other to the city.

lines.text: Ada folds the map. Biscuit waits beside the car.
You can leave before the horde reaches the river—or follow the radio deeper into the city.

choices.text: HIGHWAY — head for the open road
choices.location_text: a new highway beyond the river

choices.text: CITY — follow the signal to its source
choices.location_text: a hidden district beyond the river
